reviews.comment: This class was so difficult for no reason whatsoever.

By far the hardest tests I've taken in college. Lectures didn't help with test questions, test grades determine your grade in the class. The only way to make a decent grade is to focus on the textbook questions, go to PLTL, and basically watch a lot of organic chemistry tutor videos. Take a diff professor.

Bit coarse on the outside, but he really cares about his students. Tests are now more predictable than they were before, making the class a bit easier than in earlier years. Dr. H is always willing to talk to students, and is pretty passionate about the topics which makes classes interesting.

Do not take this class with this professor. Lectures are so unclear and do not relate to the information on the tests. Tests are based on random back of the book questions and OWL content which you have to teach all of it to yourself. If you want to succeed please do not take this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I talked grades with Tim and he laughed in my face >once. No matter how much you study, you won't know what to do on the test. Kudos to ppl that can comprehend what he talks about in class. This class assigned 42% of hw for my 17 hr semester. If you are unlucky enough to take him, do the OWLs and the end-of-chapter questions over and over again.

Definitely one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. Grad students take this class and even they struggle a bit. The material is very interesting but definitely not trivial. As long as you pay attention in class and ask questions in class/attend office hours, you will be fine. One of the best professors I've ever had-really nice and knowledgeable
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class will be very difficult if you don't already have a strong background in Chemistry. He doesn't follow the same lesson plans as other professors and gives twice the amount of homework. Book problems and problems he does in class are much easier than exam questions. The only plus is that he curves at the very end of the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I didn't have a background in chemistry when I took this class. He tends to ramble in his lectures but he is passionate about chemistry. He was very helpful during his office hours. Practice exams won't be enough to get an A in the class. The homework problems and study guide questions helped me ace his exams. He also curves the class a lot!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took his class first semester of freshman year and aced the first test. After that, I was lost. He isn't very good at updating things and I find it hard to follow along with him. He definitely lectures at a higher level. However, he curves.  He seems to be a great guy, makes good jokes. I just can't learn from him.
His tests are hard and his lecturing was hard to follow as it was taught to a higher level than most of the class seemed to be on.

He is a fair professor and seems like a nice guy, but he doesn't have a thing for teaching despite the fact that he knows chemistry in and out. I found it more beneficial to learn the material outside of class. His tests are also more difficult than the other professors. He uses iClickers in the lectures. Overall okay but there's better options.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: this guy is just too smart for his own good his tests are ridiculous.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: His seems to get personal enjoyment from confusing students and very purposefully speaks over student's understanding. The lectures are useless and I only learned from Aleks assignments. Clickers are the only reason to go to lectures. Do the practice tests before the exams. DO WHATEVER YOU CAN TO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!

He digresses during lecture and ends up not teaching enough material for the test. Yes he curves outrageously, but the class does so poorly it doesn't actually help anyone. I'd say 1/3 of his section in Spring 2016 Q-dropped.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: His lectures are confusing. Terrible professor. Don't take him.

He is not a good lecturer and he tends to not cover all the material needed to be known on the exam. In order to do well you have to read the textbook to understand the material and take your notes from there. The homework helped me prepare for the exams but there is a lot. Do the practice problems he gives before the exam!!
You will get an A if you work for it. The grades are curved, so it shouldn't be very difficult to get an A.

You have an ungodly amount of homework. He assigns two online homework assignment almost every week. The test are impossible. The practice test he gives are nothing like actual test and the "practice problems" he puts on the exam are not really there in the book.  Go to Aplus or won't pass. DO NOT TAKE HIM. he's a way more difficult prof.
He rambles. He asks no questions for comprehension. If you have a different option as a teacher, take the other option.

He is a fair professor, sometimes he goes fast but he has to cover 2 Chem classes in one, so you should expect that with whoever you take. All his power points are online but if you don't go to class they won't make sense. He is a funny guy too which is a +. He also give out study problem for the exams.  Try, go to class, and do the study problems.

It's hard to tell you what to study for this class because well..I did it all and still got a C. I read the chapters, did the end-of-chapter questions he told us to do, and fully understood the Chem OWLS and still did terrible on tests. WARNING: Watch out for the Chem OWLS he assigns...THERE'S A LOT.

This professor expects you to have an almost perfect understanding of high school chemistry before starting the course. The speed is too fast for some students and very often you will find yourself lost. The tests are hard, but the curve does bring the grade up. Attend all the Recitation classes and SI classes early on to do well in the class.

Terrible Professor. He explains things in the most complicated way possible, and even when he tries to explain problems, he purposely talks over your head. He also moves faster than all of the other professors, so even A-plus and 4.0 can't help you because they are behind teaching the other classes. Don't take his class. Take Brown
he rambles and makes class super dull. His test are hard but he curves massively
